context: Tests whether the agent creates a record with pantheon-adr, lets the branch supply the slug and type, completes the Branch ADR template, and verifies completeness with check rather than declaring it done by eye.

checklist.name: Uses pantheon-adr create
checklist.description: Creates the record with `pantheon-adr create` rather than hand-writing a markdown file. Does not invent a `new` subcommand or a `pantheon-adr`-unrelated `adr` binary.

checklist.name: Slug and type derived from the branch
checklist.description: The record is written to docs/adr/adopt-event-driven-ingestion.md with frontmatter branch_type: feat, taken from the branch feat/adopt-event-driven-ingestion. No NNNN- number prefix is invented.

checklist.name: All template headings present and ordered
checklist.description: The body contains Problem Statement (Context, Goals, Non-Goals), Decision Record (Options Considered, Chosen Solution, Rationale), Implementation (Key Changes, Testing Strategy), Challenges & Solutions, Impact Assessment, Risks & Pitfalls and Outcome & Lessons, verbatim and in that order. No metadata block is added to the body.

checklist.name: Options Considered populated and placeholders cleared
checklist.description: At least one rejected alternative with a concrete reason, and no `<!-- ... -->` comments left anywhere in the record.

checklist.name: Completeness verified with check
checklist.description: Runs `pantheon-adr check adopt-event-driven-ingestion` with the slug supplied, and reports a score of at least 80.
